title: Ukupheka
description: Ten short stories about cooking and food: a boy's first trip to the king's first-fruits ceremony at Enyokeni, a grandfather and granddaughter plucking and cooking a guinea fowl and quails in Msinga, a beginner cook in Tembisa making lamb for his mother-in-law, a young cook's contest at a Durban hotel, a Soweto Zulu class that learns adjectives, pronouns and consonants through food words, locusts roasted in Jozini after a wasp sting, a vegetable plot of red soil in Diepkloof, fried fish and a whale on the Durban coast, a Vryheid baker's survey about stale bread, and a picnic at the Johannesburg zoo.

lessons.title: Ukweshwama eNyokeni
lessons.summary: Sixteen-year-old Thabani Nhleko of Nongoma goes with his father to the king's first-fruits ceremony at Enyokeni: his mother dresses him in a skin garment, he is shy among the many men who sleep in makeshift huts, the king tastes the new crops while the crowd shouts the royal salute, a dark-brown ox is slaughtered, his father brings back the butcher's small piece of meat for them to roast, and at last Thabani eats his first watermelon of the year from a wide calabash.
lessons.text:
UThabani Nhleko uneminyaka eyishumi nesithupha. Uhlala eNongoma nabazali bakhe. Njalo ngoZibandlela inkosi yamaZulu iyeshwama eNyokeni. Ukweshwama kusho ukuthi inkosi idla izithelo zokuqala zonyaka omusha. Ngaphambi kokuthi inkosi yeshwame, abantu abadli amathanga amasha, ummbila omusha namakhabe amasha. Inkosi kumele iqale yeshwame, bese kuthi abantu badle.

Kulo nyaka uThabani uzohamba nobaba wakhe okokuqala. Ekuseni umama wakhe uyamambathisa. Umambathisa ngenjobo yesikhumba senkomo. UThabani ubheka injobo yakhe. Uthi: "Mama, le njobo iyangifanela na?" Umama uyajabula. Uthi: "Iyakufanela kahle, ndodana yami. Nobaba wakho wayegqoka injobo efana nale ngesikhathi eyinsizwa."

UThabani nobaba wakhe bafika eNyokeni kusihlwa. Kunamadoda amaningi kakhulu, amakhulu namakhulu. Bonke bagqoke izinjobo. Amadoda amaningi alala emaxhibeni. Ixhiba yindlu encane eyakhiwa ngezinti notshani, eyakhelwa izinsuku ezimbalwa kuphela. UThabani nobaba wakhe nabo balala exhibeni elincane eduze komfula.

UThabani unezinhloni. Akazi muntu lapha. Amadoda ayacula futhi ayagiya, kodwa yena umi eceleni. Ubaba wakhe uthi: "Ungabi nezinhloni, Thabani. Lawa madoda angabangane bethu." Kodwa izinhloni zikaThabani aziphelanga ngokushesha.

Ngakusasa inkosi iyaphuma. Isixuku sonke siyakhala ngezwi elikhulu: "Bayede! Bayede!" UThabani naye uthi: "Bayede!" Izwi lakhe liphezulu kakhulu, futhi ubaba wakhe uyajabula. Inkosi iyeshwama. Idla ithanga elisha, bese idla nekhabe elisha. Manje abantu bonke bangadla izithelo ezintsha. Isixuku siphinde sithi: "Bayede!"

Emva kwalokho amadoda ahlaba insundu. Insundu yinkunzi enkulu enombala onsundu. Ubaba kaThabani ungomunye wamadoda ahlinza insundu. Umuntu ohlinza inyama uthola intshontsho. Intshontsho yisiqephu esincane senyama, esinikwa umuntu osebenzile ekuhlinzeni.

Kusihlwa ubaba ubuyela exhibeni ephethe intshontsho lakhe. Uthi: "Thabani, leli yintshontsho lethu." Bosa intshontsho emlilweni ngaphandle kwexhiba. Intshontsho limnandi kakhulu.

Bese kufika umngane kababa ephethe igobongo. Igobongo yisitsha esikhulu esinomlomo obanzi. Leli gobongo ligcwele amakhabe asikiwe. Umngane uthi: "Thatha, mfana. Inkosi seyeshwamile." UThabani uthatha ikhabe egobongweni. Udla ikhabe lakhe lokuqala lonyaka. Limtoti kakhulu. Ubaba wakhe uthi: "Manje izinhloni zakho ziphelile na, Thabani?" UThabani uyahleka. Uthi: "Yebo, baba. Izinhloni zami zipheliswe yikhabe!"

Imibuzo:
Kusho ukuthini ukweshwama?
Kusho ukuthi inkosi idla izithelo zokuqala zonyaka omusha.
Umama kaThabani umambathisa ngani?
Umambathisa ngenjobo yesikhumba senkomo.
Amadoda amaningi alala kuphi eNyokeni?
Alala emaxhibeni, izindlu ezincane ezakhiwa ngezinti notshani.
Isixuku sithini lapho inkosi iphuma?
Sithi: "Bayede! Bayede!"
Ubaba kaThabani uthola intshontsho kanjani?
Ulithola ngoba ungomunye wamadoda ahlinza insundu.
UThabani udla ikhabe kuphi?
Ulidla egobongweni elikhulu.

lessons.title: Impangele kaMkhulu Mthalane
lessons.summary: In Msinga, old Mthalane comes home with a guinea fowl and two quails, and his granddaughter Nomaqhawe helps him cook them: she learns to pluck the feathers, chases away a hungry kitten, catches the box of salt her grandfather throws to her, pokes up the dying fire, watches the meat shrink in the pot, adds pepper, and eats with a fork while her grandfather eats with his hands.
lessons.text:
UMkhulu Mthalane uhlala eMsinga nomzukulu wakhe uNomaqhawe, oneminyaka eyishumi. Ngolunye usuku uMkhulu ubuya ensimini kusihlwa. Uphethe impangele enkulu nezigwaca ezimbili. Uthi: "Nomaqhawe, bheka! Namuhla sizodla impangele nezigwaca." UNomaqhawe uyajabula. Akazange adle impangele ngaphambili.

Impangele yinyoni enkulu enezimpaphe ezimnyama nezimhlophe. Isigwaca sona yinyoni encane kakhulu, esincane kunenkukhu. UMkhulu uthi: "Kuqala kumele siqhuthe izimpaphe. Woza, ngizokufundisa ukuqhutha." Uhlala phansi ngaphambi kwendlu. Ubamba impangele ngesandla esisodwa, aqhuthe izimpaphe ngesinye. Izimpaphe ziyawa phansi. UNomaqhawe uthatha isigwaca, naye aqale ukuqhutha. Isigwaca sincane, ngakho ukuqhutha kwaso kuyashesha.

Ngalesi sikhathi kufika ikatshana elimhlophe. Ikatshana lilambile. Lifuna inyama. Ligxuma phezu kwesigwaca sesibili. UNomaqhawe uyalixhosha. Uthi: "Suka! Suka lapha!" Ikatshana libaleka, kodwa libuya futhi. UNomaqhawe uyalixhosha futhi. UMkhulu uyahleka. Uthi: "Ikatshana leli lihlakaniphile. Lizobuya njalo." Ekugcineni uNomaqhawe ulinika amathambo amancane. Ikatshana lidla, lithule.

UMkhulu usika inyama, ayifake embizeni namanzi. Uthi: "Nomaqhawe, nqaka!" Uphonsa ibhokisi likasawoti. UNomaqhawe uyalinqaka ngezandla zombili. UMkhulu uthi: "Wenze kahle! Unqaka njengomdlali webhola." UNomaqhawe ufaka usawoti embizeni.

Umlilo uyancipha. UMkhulu uthi: "Khwezela umlilo, mntwana wami." UNomaqhawe uthatha induku, akhwezele umlilo. Ukhwezela kancane, bese efaka nezinkuni ezimbili. Umlilo uyavutha futhi.

Inyama ibila isikhathi eside. UNomaqhawe ubheka embizeni. Uthi: "Mkhulu, inyama iyafinyela! Isincane kunakuqala." UMkhulu uthi: "Yebo. Inyama yezinyoni iyafinyela uma ipheka isikhathi eside. Akukho lutho olubi." Bese ufaka uphepha embizeni. Uthi: "Uphepha wenza inyama ibe mnandi." UNomaqhawe unuka uphepha. Unuka kamnandi, kodwa unamandla.

Ekugcineni ukudla sekuvuthiwe. UMkhulu ubeka inyama ezitsheni ezimbili. Unika uNomaqhawe imfologo. Yena akasebenzisi imfologo. Udla ngezandla, njengabantu bakudala. UNomaqhawe uthi: "Mkhulu, kungani ungasebenzisi imfologo?" UMkhulu uthi: "Ngikhulele ngaphandle kwezimfologo. Izandla zami yizimfologo zami." Bobabili bayahleka, badle impangele nezigwaca.

Imibuzo:
UMkhulu uphetheni lapho ebuya ensimini?
Uphethe impangele enkulu nezigwaca ezimbili.
UNomaqhawe ufunda ukwenzani?
Ufunda ukuqhutha izimpaphe.
UNomaqhawe ulixhosha kanjani ikatshana?
Uthi: "Suka lapha!" kodwa ikatshana libuya futhi.
UNomaqhawe wenzani lapho umlilo uncipha?
Ukhwezela umlilo ngenduku, bese efaka nezinkuni.
Kungani inyama ifinyela?
Ngoba ipheka isikhathi eside.
UMkhulu udla ngani?
Udla ngezandla, akasebenzisi imfologo.

lessons.title: Umkhwekazi uyeza
lessons.summary: In Tembisa, Mfezeko Shandu, a beginner in the kitchen, has to cook Sunday lunch for his mother-in-law MaDlomo, who keeps sheep on her farm near Ladysmith: he phones his mother in Durban for a recipe for lamb, phones his wife Nomasonto at the hospital to ask what her mother likes, learns that MaDlomo will not eat the tough meat of an old ewe, and at the end of the meal his mother-in-law praises his efficiency in the kitchen and invites him to her farm.
lessons.text:
UMfezeko Shandu uhlala eTembisa nenkosikazi yakhe uNomasonto. NgeSonto umkhwekazi wakhe, uMaDlomo, uzobavakashela. Umkhwekazi ngumama wenkosikazi yakho. UMaDlomo uhlala epulazini eduze kwaseLadysmith. Ufuya izimvu. Unezimvukazi eziningi nezimvana eziningi.

UNomasonto ungunesi. NgeSonto ekuseni usebenza esibhedlela. Ngakho uMfezeko kumele aphekele umkhwekazi wakhe yedwa. Kodwa uMfezeko ungumqali ekhishini. Uyakwazi ukwenza itiye nesinkwa kuphela. Futhi akajwayele ukufowuna abantu ukuze acele usizo.

NgoMgqibelo uMfezeko uyafowuna. Ufowunela umama wakhe eThekwini. Uthi: "Sawubona, Mama!" Umama uthi: "Yebo, ndodana yami. Unjani?" UMfezeko uthi: "Ngiyaphila, Mama. Wena unjani?" Umama uthi: "Nami ngiyaphila. Kungani ungifowunela namuhla?"

UMfezeko uchaza ukuthi umkhwekazi wakhe uyeza. Umama uthi: "UMaDlomo ufuya izimvu, ngakho uthanda inyama yemvana. Thenga inyama yemvana esitolo. Yifake embizeni namafutha nosawoti. Yipheke kancane amahora amabili." UMfezeko ubhala konke ephepheni. Umama uthi: "Ungesabi. Wonke umpheki omkhulu waqala engumqali."

Bese uMfezeko ufowunela uNomasonto emsebenzini. Uthi: "Sawubona, sithandwa. Umama wakho uthanda imvana na?" UNomasonto uthi: "Yebo, uyayithanda imvana. Kodwa akayidli inyama yemvukazi endala. Uthi inyama yemvukazi ilukhuni kakhulu. Thenga imvana kuphela."

NgeSonto ekuseni uMfezeko uvuka ngehora lesihlanu. Uthenga inyama yemvana, ahlanze ikhishi, asike imifino. Usebenza ngokushesha futhi kahle. Imvana ipheka kancane embizeni. Indlu yonke inuka kamnandi. Ngehora leshumi uNomasonto uyafowuna esibhedlela. Uthi: "Konke kuhamba kahle na?" UMfezeko uthi: "Yebo, sithandwa. Ungakhathazeki."

Emini uMaDlomo uyafika. Uthi: "Sawubona, Mfezeko." UMfezeko uthi: "Sawubona, Mama. Ngena." UMaDlomo ubona ikhishi elihlanzekile nemifino esikiwe kahle. Uthi: "Ngiyakubona ukuqeqesheka kwakho, Mfezeko. Yonke into isendaweni yayo." UMfezeko akasho ukuthi ungumqali.

Badla ndawonye. UMaDlomo udla imvana kancane. Uthi: "Le mvana ithambile futhi imnandi. Akuyona imvukazi endala!" UMfezeko uyahleka. Esigcinweni sokudla uMaDlomo uthi: "Ngiyabonga, mkhwenyana wami. Ngifike ngikhathele, kodwa isigcino salolu suku simnandi kakhulu. Ngonyaka ozayo woza epulazini lami. Imvukazi yami enkulu izobe inezimvana. Uzongiphekela futhi ngokuqeqesheka okufana nalokhu."

Kusihlwa uNomasonto ubuya emsebenzini. Umama wakhe uthi: "Umyeni wakho akasiye umqali. Ngumpheki!"

Imibuzo:
Umkhwekazi kaMfezeko ungubani?
NguMaDlomo, umama kaNomasonto.
Kungani uMfezeko ekhathazekile?
Ngoba ungumqali ekhishini, futhi kumele aphekele umkhwekazi wakhe yedwa.
UMfezeko ufowunela obani?
Ufowunela umama wakhe eThekwini, bese efowunela uNomasonto emsebenzini.
Kungani uMaDlomo engayidli inyama yemvukazi endala?
Ngoba uthi ilukhuni kakhulu.
UMaDlomo ubonani ekhishini?
Ubona ikhishi elihlanzekile nemifino esikiwe kahle, abone ukuqeqesheka kukaMfezeko.
UMaDlomo uthini esigcinweni sokudla?
Uthi isigcino salolu suku simnandi, futhi umema epulazini lakhe.

lessons.title: Umncintiswano wabapheki abasha
lessons.summary: At a Durban hotel, the tycoon Mthimkhulu holds a cooking contest for young cooks: the guard at the door checks Lethokuhle's name, her boss at the restaurant has told her to keep her target in mind, the judge Mngomezulu asks for potato slices three millimetres thin, which Lethokuhle lays in a circle around the chicken, a clever rival named Siboniso works fast, and the judge nods at each dish before he gives Lethokuhle the winner's ribbon.
lessons.text:
UMthimkhulu uyinkinsela eThekwini. Unamahhotela amathathu nezitolo eziningi. Inkinsela le ithanda ukudla okumnandi. Njalo ngonyaka yenza umncintiswano wabapheki abasha ehhotela layo elikhulu eduze kolwandle.

Kulo nyaka uLethokuhle naye uzongena emncintiswaneni. ULethokuhle uneminyaka engamashumi amabili. Ungumpheki endaweni yokudlela encane eMlazi. Ubasi wakhe, uMhlungu, umthanda kakhulu. Ngaphambi komncintiswano ubasi uthi kuye: "Lethokuhle, ungesabi. Khumbula isigcibisholo sakho. Isigcibisholo sakho akukhona ukunqoba kuphela. Isigcibisholo sakho wukupheka kahle, kancane, futhi ngokunakekela."

NgoMgqibelo ekuseni uLethokuhle ufika ehhotela. Emnyango kumi ugadi omude. Ugadi ubheka iphepha elinamagama abapheki. Uthi: "Igama lakho ngubani?" ULethokuhle uthi: "NginguLethokuhle." Ugadi uthola igama lakhe ephepheni, avule umnyango. Uthi: "Ngena. Inhlanhla enhle!"

Ekhishini elikhulu kunabapheki abasha abayishumi. Umgwebi ungumpheki odumile, uMngomezulu. Umgwebi uthi: "Namuhla nizopheka inkukhu namazambane. Nizosika amazambane abe iziqephu ezincane, ezingamamilimitha amathathu kuphela. Hhayi amamilimitha amahlanu, hhayi amamilimitha amabili. Amamilimitha amathathu!"

Eduze kukaLethokuhle kunensizwa egama layo nguSiboniso. USiboniso uyiqili. Usebenza ngokushesha okukhulu. Usika amazambane ngaphandle kokuwabheka. ULethokuhle ucabanga: "Lo mfana uyiqili ngempela. Uhlakaniphile kakhulu." Kodwa ukhumbula amazwi kabasi wakhe. Usika kancane, abheke isiqephu ngasinye. Zonke iziqephu zingamamilimitha amathathu.

Bese uLethokuhle ubeka iziqephu zamazambane esitsheni esikhulu. Uzibeka zibe yindingilizi enkulu. Phakathi kwendingilizi ubeka inyama yenkukhu. Bese ebeka enye indingilizi encane yamazambane phezu kwenyama. Isitsha singena kuhhavini.

Ekugcineni umgwebi uhamba etafuleni ngalinye. Udla ukudla kukaSiboniso. Uyanqekuza. Ubheka iziqephu zamazambane zikaLethokuhle. Uyanqekuza futhi. Udla ukudla kwakhe. Umgwebi akasho lutho, kodwa uyanqekuza kathathu. Inkinsela, uMthimkhulu, iyajabula.

Umgwebi uthi: "Bonke nipheke kahle. USiboniso uyiqili, futhi ukudla kwakhe kumnandi. Kodwa iziqephu zakhe azilingani. Ngakho umnqobi nguLethokuhle." Inkinsela inika uLethokuhle umdweshu obomvu nemali. ULethokuhle uthatha umdweshu, awubophe engutsheni yakhe.

Kusihlwa ubasi wakhe ubona umdweshu. Uthi: "Bengazi! Awusikhohlwanga isigcibisholo sakho."

Imibuzo:
UMthimkhulu ungubani?
Uyinkinsela eThekwini enamahhotela amathathu.
Ugadi wenzani emnyango?
Ubheka igama likaLethokuhle ephepheni, avule umnyango.
Umgwebi ufuna ukuthi abapheki benzeni?
Ufuna iziqephu zamazambane ezingamamilimitha amathathu.
Kungani uLethokuhle ethi uSiboniso uyiqili?
Ngoba usebenza ngokushesha okukhulu futhi uhlakaniphile.
Umgwebi wenzani lapho edla ukudla kukaLethokuhle?
Uyanqekuza kathathu.
ULethokuhle utholani?
Uthola umdweshu obomvu nemali.

lessons.title: Isifundo samagama okudla
lessons.summary: In a Soweto classroom, Zulu teacher Nkabinde asks her pupils, who speak Tswana, Venda and Tsonga at home and one of whom, Chikondi from Malawi, speaks Tumbuka, to make sentences about their favourite food: she tells them not to shout all at once, explains adjectives with white milk and pale bread, pronouns with a mother who cooks meat, and consonants with the word for milk, and Chikondi finds that the Tumbuka word for maize porridge has consonants too.
lessons.text:
UNkabinde ungumfundisi wesiZulu esikoleni eSoweto. Ekilasini lakhe kunezingane ezingamashumi amathathu. Izingane eziningi zikhuluma isiZulu ekhaya, kodwa akuzona zonke. ULesego ukhuluma isitshwana ekhaya. URudzani ukhuluma isivenda, kanti uHlulani ukhuluma isitsonga. UChikondi uvela eMalawi. Ekhaya ukhuluma isitumbuka. Kodwa zonke lezi zingane ziyasifunda isiZulu esikoleni.

NgoLwesithathu uNkabinde uthi: "Namuhla sizofunda ngamagama okudla. Ngubani othanda ukudla?" Zonke izingane ziphakamisa izandla, bese zikhuluma ngezwi eliphezulu ndawonye: "Mina! Mina!" UNkabinde uthi: "Musani ukukhuluma nonke ngesikhathi esisodwa! Musani ukukhuluma ngezwi eliphezulu. Phakamisani izandla kuphela."

Ubhala ebhodini: "Ngithanda ubisi olumhlophe." Uthi: "Igama elithi 'olumhlophe' liyisiphawulo. Isiphawulo sisitshela ukuthi into injani. Ubisi lumhlophe. Ubumhlophe bobisi bubonakala kalula." ULesego uthi: "Mfundisi, nasesitshwaneni sineziphawulo!" UNkabinde uthi: "Yebo. Zonke izilimi zineziphawulo. Isitshwana, isivenda nesitsonga zineziphawulo."

URudzani uthi: "Ngithanda isinkwa sikamama. Kodwa isinkwa sakhe asimhlophe kakhulu. Simhloshana." UNkabinde uthi: "Kuhle, Rudzani! 'Mhloshana' kusho ukuthi into ayimhlophe ngempela, kodwa isondele ebumhlopheni. Nalo liyisiphawulo." Ubhala ebhodini: "Isinkwa esimhloshana."

Bese uNkabinde ubhala: "Umama upheka inyama. Uyipheka ekuseni." Uthi: "Bhekani igama elithi 'yena' negama elithi 'yona'. Lawa magama ayizabizwana. Isabizwana singena esikhundleni segama. Esikhundleni sokuthi 'umama', sithi 'yena'. Esikhundleni sokuthi 'inyama', sithi 'yona'."

UHlulani uyabuza: "Mfundisi, ungwaqa yini?" UNkabinde ubhala igama elithi 'ubisi' ebhodini. Uthi: "Bhekani. Kuleli gama kunemisindo emihlanu. Umsindo wesibili ungwaqa, nowesine ungwaqa. Ungwaqa ngumsindo owenziwa lapho umoya uvalwa kancane emlonyeni, ngezindebe noma ngolimi. Ngakho igama elithi 'ubisi' linongwaqa ababili."

UChikondi uthula isikhathi eside. Ekugcineni uthi: "Mfundisi, esitumbukeni ukudla okwenziwa ngommbila sithi 'nsima'. Igama elithi 'nsima' nalo linongwaqa." UNkabinde uyajabula. Uthi: "Kuhle kakhulu, Chikondi! Isitumbuka nesiZulu zifana ngezinto eziningi. Zonke izilimi zinezabizwana, iziphawulo nongwaqa."

Ngemuva kwesikole uChikondi ugijima ekhaya. Utshela umama wakhe ngesifundo. Uthi: "Mama, namuhla ngifunde ngesiphawulo, ngesabizwana nangongwaqa. Futhi bengingesabi ukukhuluma ngesitumbuka!"

Imibuzo:
Izingane zekilasi likaNkabinde zikhuluma ziphi izilimi ekhaya?
Zikhuluma isiZulu, isitshwana, isivenda, isitsonga nesitumbuka.
UNkabinde uthini lapho izingane zikhuluma ndawonye?
Uthi: "Musani ukukhuluma nonke ngesikhathi esisodwa!"
Isiphawulo senzani?
Sisitshela ukuthi into injani, njengokuthi ubisi lumhlophe.
Kusho ukuthini ukuthi isinkwa simhloshana?
Kusho ukuthi asimhlophe ngempela, kodwa sisondele ebumhlopheni.
Isabizwana sisebenza kanjani?
Singena esikhundleni segama, njengokuthi "yena" esikhundleni sokuthi "umama".
UChikondi uthini ngegama elithi "nsima"?
Uthi esitumbukeni lisho ukudla okwenziwa ngommbila, futhi linongwaqa.

lessons.title: Izintethe zikaGogo Masinga
lessons.summary: In Jozini, a swarm of locusts lands in Gogo Masinga's field, and she tells her grandson Mfanakithi that in a famine long ago people roasted and ate locusts: they catch some while small birds eat the rest, Mfanakithi climbs a tree to watch a woodpecker and a wasp stings his hand, the hand throbs until his grandmother rubs ointment on it and he lies down, the swelling goes down, and they eat roasted locusts together.
lessons.text:
UGogo Masinga uhlala eJozini nomzukulu wakhe uMfanakithi. Ngelinye ilanga ehlobo kufika izintethe eziningi ensimini kaGogo. Izintethe zigxuma phezu kotshani, zidle nommbila. UMfanakithi uyesaba. Uthi: "Gogo, izintethe zizodla wonke ummbila wethu!"

UGogo uthi: "Ungesabi, mntwana. Izintethe zifika, ziphinde zihambe. Kodwa kudala abantu babedla izintethe." UMfanakithi uyamangala. Uthi: "Abantu babedla izintethe? Kungani?" UGogo uthi: "Kudala kwaba nephango elikhulu lapha. Imvula ayizange ine iminyaka emibili. Ummbila awuzange ukhule. Ngesikhathi sephango abantu babelambile kakhulu. Ngakho babebamba izintethe, bese bezibeka emlilweni ukuze zivuthwe. Iphango laliyinto embi, kodwa izintethe zasiza abantu abaningi."

Bobabili baqala ukubamba izintethe. Bazifaka esikhwameni. Ngalesi sikhathi kufika izintaka ezincane eziningi. Izintaka nazo zidla izintethe. UGogo uthi: "Bheka, izintaka ziyasisiza. Izintethe zimnandi ezintakeni. Izintaka zidla izintethe njengoba thina sidla inyama."

Esihlahleni esikhulu eduze kwensimu kunesiqopha. Isiqopha sishaya isihlahla ngomlomo waso kaningi. Umsindo wesiqopha uzwakala kude. UMfanakithi ufuna ukusibona kahle. Ugibela esihlahleni. Kodwa esihlahleni kunomuvi. Umuvi umluma esandleni.

UMfanakithi uyakhala. Wehla esihlahleni ngokushesha. Isandla sakhe siyaqaqamba. Sivuvukala. Uthi: "Gogo, umuvi wangenzakalisa! Isandla siyaqaqamba kakhulu!" UGogo uthi: "Woza lapha. Ake ngibone. Umuvi awukwenzakalisanga kakhulu. Imivi iyaluma, kodwa ayibulali. Ngizokusiza."

UGogo ungena endlini, aphume nesigcobo. Isigcobo sakhe sinuka njengemithi yesintu. Uhlikihla isigcobo esandleni sikaMfanakithi kancane. Uthi: "Manje cambalala lapha emthunzini. Ungasinyakazi isandla." UMfanakithi ucambalala phansi kotshani. Ucambalala isikhathi eside.

Ngemuva kwehora isandla sakhe siyabohla. Asisaqaqambi kakhulu. UGogo ubeka isigcobo futhi. Uthi: "Bheka, siyabohla. Kusasa isandla sakho sizobe siphilile." Ekugcineni isandla sibohla ngokuphelele. UMfanakithi uthi: "Ngiyabonga, Gogo. Angeke ngiphinde ngigibele isihlahla esinemivi."

Kusihlwa uGogo ubasa umlilo. Wosa izintethe emlilweni. UMfanakithi uthatha intethe eyodwa, ayidle. Uthi: "Hawu, Gogo! Intethe imnandi!" UGogo uyahleka. Uthi: "Manje uyazi ukuthi abantu baphila kanjani ngesikhathi sephango."

Imibuzo:
Kwenzekani ensimini kaGogo Masinga?
Kufika izintethe eziningi, zigxuma phezu kotshani.
Kungani abantu babedla izintethe kudala?
Ngoba kwaba nephango elikhulu, futhi babelambile.
Izintaka ezincane zenzani?
Zidla izintethe, zisize uGogo noMfanakithi.
Kungani uMfanakithi egibela esihlahleni?
Ufuna ukubona isiqopha kahle.
Kwenzekani esandleni sikaMfanakithi ngemuva kokulunywa ngumuvi?
Siyaqaqamba futhi sivuvukala.
UGogo umsiza kanjani?
Uhlikihla isigcobo esandleni sakhe, amtshele ukuthi acambalale emthunzini.

lessons.title: Isiqinti sikaNomandla
lessons.summary: In Diepkloof, Nomandla Mabhena, who loves to cook with fresh vegetables, gets a small plot of land beside her yard: she takes apart an old broken fence, digs the red soil with a shovel, checks the depth of each hole, pokes small holes for the bean seeds with a stick, plants a small aloe in the corner for burns from the kitchen, and lets the climbing bean plants grow up the yard wall until she can cook her first beans.
lessons.text:
UNomandla Mabhena uhlala eDiepkloof eSoweto. Uthanda ukupheka, kodwa akathandi imifino yasesitolo. Uthi: "Imifino yasesitolo ayimnandi njengemifino yasensimini." Iyadi lakhe lincane kakhulu. Ngakho ngelinye ilanga uthenga isiqinti esincane eduze kweyadi lakhe.

Isiqinti asisihle. Kunothango oludala oluphukile, nezinto eziningi ezingasebenzi. UNomandla uthi: "Kuqala kumele ngiqhaqhe lolu thango." NgoMgqibelo ekuseni uqala ukuqhaqha uthango. Uqhaqha izinti ngazinye, azibeke eceleni kweyadi. Ukuqhaqha uthango kumthatha usuku lonke.

NgeSonto uthatha ifosholo lakhe elisha. Umba isiqinti ngefosholo. Inhlabathi yalesi siqinti ibomvu. Umakhelwane wakhe uthi: "Lesi yisibomvu. Isibomvu siyinhlabathi enhle yemifino, kodwa sidinga amanzi amaningi." UNomandla uyajabula. Umba isibomvu ngefosholo kuze kube semini.

UNomandla ufuna ukutshala ubhontshisi namathanga. Umba imigodi emincane. Ubuza umakhelwane: "Injula yomgodi kumele ibe njani?" Umakhelwane uthi: "Injula yomgodi wethanga kumele ilingane nesandla sakho. Kodwa imbewu kabhontshisi ayidingi injula enkulu." UNomandla ulinganisa injula yomgodi ngamunye ngesandla sakhe.

Bese uthatha induku encane. Uhlokoloza inhlabathi ngenduku, enze izimbobo ezincane. Uhlokoloza kancane, ngoba imbewu kabhontshisi incane. Embobeni ngayinye ubeka imbewu eyodwa. Uhlokoloza futhi, aze aqede.

Eceleni lesiqinti uNomandla utshala inhlaba. Inhlaba yisitshalo esincane esinamanzi amaningi ngaphakathi. Abantu abaningi baseSoweto batshala inhlaba emayadini abo. Uthi: "Uma ngishiswa ngumlilo ekhishini, ngizobeka amanzi enhlaba esandleni." Unina wamfundisa lokho kudala, lapho uNomandla eyingane encane.

Njalo kusihlwa uNomandla uchela isiqinti sakhe, ngoba isibomvu sidinga amanzi amaningi. Ngemuva kwamasonto amaningi ubhontshisi uyakhula. Ubhontshisi wakhe uyimbambe. Imbambe yisitshalo esikhwela ezintweni ezinde. Imbambe kaNomandla ikhwela odongeni lweyadi. Ikhula ngokushesha, iluhlaza, inezimbali ezimhlophe.

Ekugcineni ngolunye usuku uNomandla ukha ubhontshisi wakhe wokuqala. Uwupheka nenyama, usawoti namafutha. Ubiza umakhelwane wakhe. Umakhelwane uthi: "Ubhontshisi wesiqinti sakho umnandi kunowesitolo!" UNomandla uthi: "Ngoba ukhule esibomvu sethu."

Imibuzo:
Kungani uNomandla ethenga isiqinti?
Ngoba uthanda imifino yasensimini, futhi iyadi lakhe lincane kakhulu.
UNomandla wenzani ngothango oludala?
Uyaluqhaqha, abeke izinti eceleni kweyadi.
Inhlabathi yesiqinti injani?
Yisibomvu, inhlabathi ebomvu edinga amanzi amaningi.
Injula yomgodi wethanga kumele ibe njani?
Kumele ilingane nesandla sikaNomandla.
UNomandla uhlokoloza inhlabathi ngani?
Uyihlokoloza ngenduku encane.
Kungani uNomandla etshala inhlaba?
Ngoba amanzi enhlaba asiza uma umuntu eshiswa ngumlilo.

lessons.title: Umkhomo nolwandle
lessons.summary: Bhekizenzo takes his daughter Mbalentle from Polokwane to Durban for her first sight of the sea: a piece of news on his phone says a whale has been seen near the coast, they ride along the beach in a rickshaw, watch surfers glide on the waves, eat fried fish by a lagoon with a marsh full of birds, and from the far shore they finally see the whale blow water while Mbalentle's laughter rings out.
lessons.text:
UBhekizenzo uhlala ePolokwane nendodakazi yakhe uMbalentle. UMbalentle uneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili. Akazange alubone ulwandle. Ngakho ngamaholide uBhekizenzo uhamba naye eThekwini.

Ekuseni ehhotela uBhekizenzo ufunda incingo ocingweni lwakhe. Uyifundela uMbalentle. Incingo ithi: "Izolo kubonakale umkhomo omkhulu eduze kogu lwaseThekwini." UMbalentle uthi: "Baba, umkhomo yini?" UBhekizenzo uthi: "Umkhomo yisilwane esikhulu kakhulu solwandle. Umkhomo mkhulu kunebhasi." UMbalentle uthi: "Ngifuna ukuwubona!"

Ogwini lwaseThekwini kunamalisho amaningi. Ilisho yinqola enamasondo amabili. Umuntu olidonsayo ugijima ngaphambi kwalo. Abadonsa amalisho bagqoka izinto ezinemibala eminingi ekhanda. UBhekizenzo uthi: "Woza, Mbalentle. Sizogibela ilisho." Bagibela ilisho, lihambe eduze kogu. Indoda edonsa ilisho iyagxuma, futhi uMbalentle uyahleka. Uhleko lwakhe luzwakala kude.

Olwandle kunabantu abantweza emagagasini. UMbalentle uthi: "Baba, bheka umfana lowaya! Untweza phezu kwegagasi!" Umfana lowaya untweza kahle kakhulu. Bese ewa emanzini. UMbalentle uyahleka futhi. UBhekizenzo uthi: "Ukuntweza kunzima. Kumele ufunde isikhathi eside."

Emini baya ngasenyakatho kwedolobha. Lapho kukhona umtata omkhulu. Umtata yindawo lapho amanzi omfula ehlangana namanzi olwandle. Eduze komtata kunesihlamba. Isihlamba yindawo enamanzi amancane notshani obude. Ezinyonini eziningi isihlamba siyikhaya. Bahlala eduze komtata, badle inhlanzi ethosiwe namazambane.

Ngesikhathi bedla kufika enye incingo ocingweni lukaBhekizenzo: "Umkhomo ubonakala manje ngasenyakatho kwedolobha!" UBhekizenzo umi phezulu. Ubheka olwandle. Uthi: "Mbalentle, bheka ulwandle loluya! Ngaphesheya kogu loluya!" Kude olwandle kukhona into enkulu emnyama. Umkhomo! Umkhomo lowaya uphefumula, kuphume amanzi phezulu. UMbalentle uthi: "Baba, umkhomo lowaya mkhulu kunendlu yethu!"

UMbalentle ugxuma ngoba ujabule kakhulu. Uhleko lwakhe luzwakala kuso sonke isihlamba. Izinyoni ziyandiza zisuka esihlambeni. Bese umkhomo ungena emanzini, ungabonakali futhi.

Kusihlwa uMbalentle ushayela umama wakhe ucingo ePolokwane. Uthi: "Mama, ngibone umkhomo! Ngigibele ilisho! Ngibone abafana abantweza!" Umama uyahleka. Uthi: "Lezo yizincingo ezinhle kakhulu, ntombazane yami."

Imibuzo:
Incingo yokuqala ocingweni ithini?
Ithi kubonakale umkhomo omkhulu eduze kogu lwaseThekwini.
Ilisho yini?
Yinqola enamasondo amabili, edonswa ngumuntu ogijimayo.
UMbalentle ubonani olwandle?
Ubona umfana ontweza phezu kwegagasi, bese ewa emanzini.
Umtata yini?
Yindawo lapho amanzi omfula ehlangana namanzi olwandle.
Izinyoni zenzani lapho uMbalentle ehleka?
Ziyandiza zisuka esihlambeni.
Umkhomo wenzani kude olwandle?
Uyaphefumula, kuphume amanzi phezulu.

lessons.title: Isinkwa esingaduvi
lessons.summary: In Vryheid, baker Ndwandwe runs a survey among his customers and learns they want bread that does not go stale by the afternoon, so he decides to bake twice a day with his young helper Thulebona: on the first morning Thulebona lets the oven fire die down, the lid of the sugar tin comes off and he slips and falls on his bottom, the rolled cloth over the unbaked loaves comes undone, but Ndwandwe calmly shows him how to dribble oil in small amounts, and by the evening the fresh bread is sold out.
lessons.text:
UNdwandwe unendawo yokubhaka isinkwa eVryheid. Ubhaka isinkwa njalo ekuseni. Kodwa ngonyaka lo abantu abambalwa kuphela abathenga isinkwa sakhe. UNdwandwe ufuna ukwazi ukuthi kungani. Ngakho wenza uhlolovo. Ubuza wonke umuntu ongena esitolo sakhe: "Uthandani ngesinkwa sami? Yini ongayithandi?"

Ngemuva kwamasonto amabili uNdwandwe ufunda izimpendulo zohlolovo. Abantu abaningi bathi: "Isinkwa sakho simnandi ekuseni, kodwa emva kwemini siyaduva." Uhlolovo lukhombisa ukuthi abantu bafuna isinkwa esisha kusihlwa futhi. UNdwandwe uthi: "Uhlolovo lungifundisile okuthile. Isinkwa sami siyaduva ngoba ngibhaka kanye ngosuku. Manje ngizobhaka kabili."

UNdwandwe usizwa yinsizwa entsha, uThulebona. UThulebona uneminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalolunye. Ekuseni kokuqala uNdwandwe uthi: "Thulebona, nakekela umlilo kahhavini. Ungawuvumeli ulothe." Kodwa uThulebona ubuka ucingo lwakhe. Umlilo uyalotha kancane kancane. Lapho uNdwandwe ebuya, umlilo usulothile. Isinkwa asivuthwanga. UThulebona uthi: "Ngiyaxolisa. Bekungubuthutha bami."

UNdwandwe akathukutheli. Uthi: "Wonke umuntu wenza ubuthutha kanye. Kodwa ungabuphindi." Bayakhwezela umlilo ndawonye, kuze kuvuthe kahle futhi.

Bese uThulebona uthatha ithini likashukela. Isivalo sethini siyakhumuka, ushukela uchitheke phansi. UThulebona uyashelela kushukela. Uwa phansi ngesibunu. Isibunu sakhe simhlophe ngoshukela. UNdwandwe uyahleka. Uthi: "Isivalo siyakhumuka ngoba asivalwanga kahle. Futhi isibunu sakho sizophila!"

Etafuleni kukhona izinkwa ezingakavuthwa, zimbozwe ngendwangu egoqiwe. Kodwa indwangu iyasombuluka, iwe phansi. UNdwandwe uthi: "Indwangu iyasombuluka uma ungayibophi. Yibophe ngentambo." UThulebona ubopha indwangu, ingasombuluki futhi.

Ekugcineni uNdwandwe ufundisa uThulebona ukuchathaza amafutha. Uthi: "Ungafaki amafutha onke ngesikhathi esisodwa. Chathaza kancane phezu kwesinkwa ngasinye." UThulebona uchathaza amafutha kancane, ngokunakekela.

Kusihlwa isinkwa esisha siphuma kuhhavini. Abantu bayangena esitolo. Ngehora lesithupha sonke isinkwa sesithengiwe. UNdwandwe uthi: "Uhlolovo lwethu belulungile. Abantu abafuni isinkwa esiduvile."

Imibuzo:
Kungani uNdwandwe enza uhlolovo?
Ufuna ukwazi ukuthi kungani abantu abambalwa kuphela bathenga isinkwa sakhe.
Uhlolovo lukhombisani?
Lukhombisa ukuthi isinkwa siyaduva emva kwemini, futhi abantu bafuna isinkwa esisha kusihlwa.
Kwenzekani emlilweni kahhavini?
Umlilo uyalotha ngoba uThulebona ubuka ucingo lwakhe.
UThulebona uwa kanjani?
Isivalo sethini siyakhumuka, ashelele kushukela, awe ngesibunu.
Kungani indwangu isombuluka?
Isombuluka ngoba uThulebona akayibophanga ngentambo.
UNdwandwe ufundisa uThulebona ukwenzani?
Umfundisa ukuchathaza amafutha kancane phezu kwesinkwa ngasinye.

lessons.title: Ukudla ngaphandle ezilwaneni
lessons.summary: Nine-year-old Nonkqubela has a picnic at the Johannesburg zoo with her mother Mpanza: her mother plaits her hair in the morning, they watch meerkats stand up to look around, an elephant takes a cabbage with its trunk and drinks the murky water of its pond, Nonkqubela knocks her elbow against the table so that a plate falls and breaks into pieces, a band plays music with a strong beat and they dance, and at home her mother makes her brush her teeth after the sweets.
lessons.text:
UNonkqubela uneminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye. Uhlala eGoli nomama wakhe, uMpanza. NgoMgqibelo bazodla ukudla kwasemini ngaphandle, ezilwaneni eziseGoli. Ekuseni uMpanza uqhina izinwele zikaNonkqubela. Uziqhina kancane, abophe izinwele ngentambo ebomvu. UNonkqubela uthi: "Mama, uyakwazi ukuqhina kahle!" UMpanza uthi: "Umama wami wangifundisa ukuqhina lapho ngiyingane."

UMpanza ubeka ukudla esikhwameni esikhulu: isinkwa, inkukhu, amaqanda, izithelo, ujusi noswidi. Bahamba ngebhasi.

Ezilwaneni baqala babone amabhibhi. Ububhibhi yisilwane esincane esinsundu. Amabhibhi ayasukuma ngemilenze emibili, abheke yonke indawo. UNonkqubela uthi: "Mama, bheka! Amabhibhi asukuma njengabantu!" Ububhibhi obukhulu bume phezu kwetshe, bubheke phezulu. UMpanza uthi: "Lobu bubhibhi buyalinda. Bubheka izinyoni ezinkulu ezingadla amabhibhi."

Bese baya endlovini. Indlovu inkulu kakhulu. Umsebenzi uyiphonsela iklabishi. Indlovu ithatha iklabishi ngomboko wayo, ilifake emlonyeni. UNonkqubela uthi: "Indlovu idla ngomboko!" Umsebenzi uthi: "Yebo. Umboko uyisandla sendlovu. Indlovu iphuza amanzi ngomboko futhi." Indlovu ifaka umboko echibini. Amanzi echibi amdaka, ngoba indlovu iyawanyakazisa. Bese indlovu iziphonsela amanzi amdaka emzimbeni ngomboko. UNonkqubela uyahleka.

Emini bahlala etafuleni ngaphansi kwesihlahla esikhulu. UMpanza ubeka izitsha etafuleni. UNonkqubela ugijima uyohlala. Ugqula itafula ngengalo yakhe. Isitsha siyawa phansi, siphuke sibe izihlephu eziningi. UNonkqubela uthi: "Ngiyaxolisa, Mama! Ngigqule itafula." UMpanza uthi: "Akukho lutho. Kodwa ungathinti izihlephu. Isihlephu ngasinye singakusika." Uqoqa izihlephu ngephepha, azilahle emgqonyeni.

Emva kokudla kukhona iqembu labaculi eduze kwesihlahla. Abaculi badlala umculo onebhithi elinamandla. UNonkqubela uthi: "Mama, uzwa ibhithi? Woza sidanse!" Bobabili bayadansa ngebhithi lomculo. Abanye abantu nabo bayadansa. Ibhithi liqhubeka isikhathi eside. Ekugcineni abaculi bayaphumula.

Kusihlwa basekhaya. UNonkqubela ukhathele, kodwa ujabule. Udle uswidi omningi namuhla. UMpanza umnika isixubho. Uthi: "Ngaphambi kokulala, xubha amazinyo akho ngesixubho." UNonkqubela uthatha isixubho sakhe esibomvu. Uxubha amazinyo kahle. Bese elala, aphuphe ngamabhibhi nangendlovu.

Imibuzo:
UMpanza wenzani ekuseni?
Uqhina izinwele zikaNonkqubela, azibophe ngentambo ebomvu.
Amabhibhi enzani?
Ayasukuma ngemilenze emibili, abheke izinyoni ezinkulu.
Indlovu isebenzisa umboko wayo kanjani?
Ithatha iklabishi ngomboko, iphuze amanzi ngawo.
Kungani amanzi echibi amdaka?
Ngoba indlovu iyawanyakazisa.
Kwenzekani lapho uNonkqubela egqula itafula?
Isitsha siyawa phansi, siphuke sibe izihlephu.
UMpanza unikani uNonkqubela kusihlwa?
Umnika isixubho ukuze axubhe amazinyo.
